about_the_game:
8bit Happy Vibes is an official DLC for RPG Maker, which consists of a collection of retro

music and sound effects. All these audio tracks and effects have been composed on an

actual Game hard to add authenticity to the sound.

 

This is an ideal pack if you work in the video game industry but don’t have time or

budget to hire a musician, especially if you plan to add chiptune sounds to your projects.

This audio pack is best used within a pixel art project.

 

■ 16 music tracks

These tracks can run on an actual Game hard and have been composed on an actual

Game hard for a better authenticity,

 

■ More than 50 audio SFX.

Ready-to-use audio SFX for your projects.

 

■ Happy vibes to add happiness to your projects!

These tracks are all happy and upbeat! Of course, these are best used for activities such

as mini-games or happy events occurring in your games.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------

Contents

 

【audio bgm】

 

・Audio BGM : 16 tracks.

 

【audio bgs 】

・Audio SE : 51 SFX.

 -----------------------------------------------------------------------

・This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.

・OK to be used in Commercial projects made in RPG Maker

・You may modify some of the assets (but not redistribute them) for your own game use only.
